_comment: Phase 1e C1: churn storm, 50 subscriber slots on one track at a fixed 4 Mb/s each (200 Mb/s relay egress). Joins fill in ~5 s, churn escalates with stream age, and a 20 s exodus drains the group at the end. Deliberately the same offered egress as C0 (c1-steady-50.json, churn_rate 0) so C1 - C0 isolates churn at a fixed rate.
